result.instructions: Tools for Freshsales, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals are in my open-deals view, and which close this month?"; "Find the contact with the email jane@example.com and show her notes and open tasks."; "Add a note to the Acme account: renewal call went well, send the quote Friday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Freshsales data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run freshsales_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run freshsales_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run freshsales_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. freshsales_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: freshsales_list_contact_views
tools.title: List contact views
tools.description: List the saved contact views (filters) of the account, e.g. 'My Contacts', 'New Contacts', 'All Contacts'. A view id is needed by freshsales_list_contacts; ids differ per account. GET /contacts/filters.

tools.name: freshsales_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts in a view (get view_id from freshsales_list_contact_views), 25 per page with name, email, phone numbers, job title, lead score, open deals amount and last contacted. Pages: use next_page. GET /contacts/view/{view_id}.

sort_type.description: Sort direction (default: the view's own order).

tools.name: freshsales_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id with all its fields, optionally with related records embedded via include (notes, tasks, appointments, deals, sales_accounts, owner, sales_activities...). GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_search
tools.title: Search records
tools.description: Search by name/email text across one record type: contact, sales_account (company), deal or user. Returns id, type, name and email for the matches (up to per_page, default 10). Use the id with the get tools. GET /search.

tools.name: freshsales_lookup
tools.title: Look up by exact field
tools.description: Exact-match lookup of contacts, companies or deals by one field, e.g. a contact by email address. field is 'email' (contacts), 'name', or a custom field name (cf_...). Returns the full records. GET /lookup.

value.description: The exact value to find, e.g. jane@example.com.

field.description: Field to match: email, name, or a custom field name (cf_...).

tools.name: freshsales_list_account_views
tools.title: List account views
tools.description: List the saved account (company) views of the account, e.g. 'My Accounts'. A view id is needed by freshsales_list_accounts. GET /sales_accounts/filters.

tools.name: freshsales_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the accounts (companies) in a view (view_id from freshsales_list_account_views), 25 per page, with name, location, open deals amount and last contacted. GET /sales_accounts/view/{view_id}.

sort_type.description: Sort direction (default: the view's own order).

tools.name: freshsales_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: One account (company) by id with its fields, optionally with related records embedded (contacts, deals, tasks, appointments, owner...). GET /sales_accounts/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_list_deal_views
tools.title: List deal views
tools.description: List the saved deal views of the account, e.g. 'Open Deals'. A view id is needed by freshsales_list_deals. GET /deals/filters.

tools.name: freshsales_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List the deals in a view (view_id from freshsales_list_deal_views), 25 per page, with name, amount, expected close, probability and age. GET /deals/view/{view_id}.

sort_type.description: Sort direction (default: the view's own order).

tools.name: freshsales_get_deal
tools.title: Get deal
tools.description: One deal by id with amount, expected close, probability and ids of its stage, pipeline and owner, optionally with related records embedded (contacts, sales_account, deal_stage, owner, notes via sales_activities...). GET /deals/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks by status filter: open, due_today, due_tomorrow, overdue or completed (one filter per call). Returns title, due date, owner and status. GET /tasks.

tools.name: freshsales_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by id. GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments that are open (upcoming) or complete (one filter per call), with title, time, location and creator. GET /appointments.

tools.name: freshsales_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: One appointment by id with its attendees. GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_list_sales_activities
tools.title: List sales activities
tools.description: List logged sales activities (calls, meetings, emails...) of the account. GET /sales_activities.

tools.name: freshsales_list_owners
tools.title: List owners (users)
tools.description: List the users of the account (id and name). Use the id as owner_id when creating or updating records. GET /selector/owners.

tools.name: freshsales_list_deal_pipelines
tools.title: List deal pipelines
tools.description: List the deal pipelines (id, name). GET /selector/deal_pipelines.

tools.name: freshsales_list_deal_stages
tools.title: List deal stages
tools.description: List deal stages (id, name, deal_pipeline_id): those of the default pipeline, or of the pipeline given by pipeline_id. Use the id as deal_stage_id. GET /selector/deal_stages or /selector/deal_pipelines/{id}/deal_stages.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline id (freshsales_list_deal_pipelines); default pipeline when omitted.

tools.name: freshsales_list_options
tools.title: List option values
tools.description: List the configured choices (id and name) for a field: lead_sources, contact_statuses, lifecycle_stages, deal_types, deal_reasons, deal_products, deal_payment_statuses, territories, currencies, industry_types, business_types, campaigns, sales_activity_types, sales_activity_outcomes. Use the ids in the *_id fields of the write tools. GET /selector/{kind}.

tools.name: freshsales_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact. Freshsales requires an email or a mobile number. It may create a duplicate of an existing contact: search first (freshsales_lookup by email). POST /contacts.

sales_accounts.description: Companies the contact belongs to: [{id, is_primary}], at most 10, exactly one primary.

custom_field.description: Custom field values keyed by field name, e.g. {"cf_is_active": true}. Field names start with cf_.

tools.name: freshsales_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact; only the fields you pass are changed (passing sales_accounts replaces the associated companies). PUT /contacts/{id}.

sales_accounts.description: Companies the contact belongs to: [{id, is_primary}], at most 10, exactly one primary.

custom_field.description: Custom field values keyed by field name, e.g. {"cf_is_active": true}. Field names start with cf_.

tools.name: freshsales_create_account
tools.title: Create account
tools.description: WRITE: create an account (company). name is required. It may duplicate an existing company: search first (freshsales_search). POST /sales_accounts.

custom_field.description: Custom field values keyed by field name, e.g. {"cf_is_active": true}. Field names start with cf_.

tools.name: freshsales_update_account
tools.title: Update account
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing account (company); only the fields you pass are changed. PUT /sales_accounts/{id}.

custom_field.description: Custom field values keyed by field name, e.g. {"cf_is_active": true}. Field names start with cf_.

tools.name: freshsales_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal. name, amount and sales_account_id are required; contact_ids attach existing contacts. Stage and pipeline default to the first of the default pipeline. POST /deals.

amount.description: Deal value in the account's default currency.

custom_field.description: Custom field values keyed by field name, e.g. {"cf_is_active": true}. Field names start with cf_.

contact_ids.description: Existing contact ids to attach to the deal.

tools.name: freshsales_update_deal
tools.title: Update deal
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing deal, e.g. move it to another stage (deal_stage_id), change amount or expected close; only the fields you pass are changed. PUT /deals/{id}.

amount.description: Deal value in the deal's own currency (a multi-currency account: freshsales_get_deal shows the deal's currency first when updating).

sales_account_id.description: Company the deal belongs to (freshsales_search sales_account).

custom_field.description: Custom field values keyed by field name, e.g. {"cf_is_active": true}. Field names start with cf_.

remove_contact_ids.description: Contact ids to detach from the deal.

tools.name: freshsales_create_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a contact, account or deal. Visible to your team on the record. POST /notes.

target_type.description: What the record is attached to: Contact, SalesAccount (company) or Deal.

target_id.description: Id of the contact, account or deal.

tools.name: freshsales_update_note
tools.title: Update note
tools.description: WRITE: replace the text of an existing note. PUT /notes/{id}.

tools.name: freshsales_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task (to-do) attached to a contact, account or deal. title, due_date, owner_id and the target are required. POST /tasks.

due_date.description: Due date and time, ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z.

target_type.description: What the record is attached to: Contact, SalesAccount (company) or Deal.

target_id.description: Id of the contact, account or deal.

tools.name: freshsales_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: change a task: title, details, due date, owner, or mark it completed (status 1) or open (status 0). PUT /tasks/{id}.

due_date.description: New due date and time, ISO 8601 with a timezone.

tools.name: freshsales_create_appointment
tools.title: Create appointment
tools.description: WRITE: create an appointment (meeting) with a start and end, optionally attached to a contact, account or deal and with attendees. Attendees may be notified by Freshsales. POST /appointments.

from_date.description: Start, ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z.

end_date.description: End, ISO 8601 with a timezone; after from_date.

target_type.description: What the record is attached to: Contact, SalesAccount (company) or Deal.

target_id.description: Id of the contact, account or deal (with target_type).

prompts.title: Get started with Freshsales
prompts.description: What you can do with Freshsales here, with example requests to try.
